notes.title: Update #2 is live!
notes.notes:
The latest update for Cargo 3 is now available! 

Known gameplay problems:

GP00 Minor fixes / Solved
GP01 Collison near doors sometimes blocks player / Solved
GP02 Nightvision "white screen" appears / Solved
GP03 Performance is horrible / Solved
GP04 Enemy animations are bugged when shooting them with the chaingun. For some reason the AI triggers them to teleport and freeze in front of character / Solved
GP05 Checkpoint loads improvements / Solved
GP06 Few hidden doors with no collision / Solved
GP07 Better Visibility for red, green, blue cards / Solved

Feel free to share your feedbacks to help us improving the game even more.

notes.title: Update #1 is live!
notes.notes:
The latest update for Cargo 3 is now available! 

We’ve been working on improvements to make the game more friendly to new players while keeping its unique spirit. It’s just a hard start in first project on Steam Platform though, so stay tuned. 

- T01 Double tapping "escape" forcefully closes the game / Solved 
- T02 Pressing F1 triggers dev wire mode / Solved 
- T03 Pressing F3 forcefully closes the game / Solved 
- T04 Console can be used "~" / Solved 
- T05 Game is stuck to 32bit only / Solved 

Feel free to share your feedbacks to help us improving the game even more. 

Thanks for all the support! 

Vinci Games Team
